name: KiPng
description: Requires Enable KiCad API in Preferences > Plugins. Quickly export high-quality 3D renders of your PCB with ready-to-use presets.
description_full:
KiCad API required. In KiCad, open Preferences > Plugins and turn on Enable KiCad API to use KiPng. Then open a board in PCB Editor and click 3D Preview.

Preview your PCB with unsaved edits and export ray-traced or viewport PNGs at up to 4K. Choose from preset solder mask colors, backgrounds, and aspect ratios, then fine-tune the framing and lighting.
